name: Homepage
description: A configurable start page with links to your apps and their status. The first configuration lists the apps installed by this manager; your edits are kept afterwards.

volumes.name: config
volumes.description: services.yaml, settings.yaml and the other YAML files (edit them here).

inputs.label: Public hostname (optional)
inputs.help: If you will publish Homepage (e.g. home.example.com), enter it so Homepage accepts requests for it.

files.content:
# Homepage settings, generated once by the Deployment Manager; your edits are kept.
title: Home lab
theme: dark
color: slate
headerStyle: boxed

- greeting:
    text_size: xl
    text: Home lab
- datetime:
    format:
      dateStyle: long
      timeStyle: short
# Docker integration is off on purpose (no Docker socket). See https://gethomepage.dev/configs/docker/ for a read-only socket proxy.

security: No Docker socket and no API keys: the page shows links and HTTP status only, never Docker or Traefik controls.
Homepage has no login unless you enable it; publish it behind Cloudflare Access.

update.notes: Configuration files in the project folder are kept across updates.
